versions.content: Timestamp provided via application software If IdsMTimes- tampOption is set to "`Custom"', and the SEv is reported without a timestamp param- eter, then IdsM shall request a timestamp from the application via the Timestamp- Provider callback and add the received timestamp to the QSEv .
